'''Hilbert''' (Japanese: '''トウヤ''' ''Touya'') is the male [[player character]] in {{game|Black and White|s}}. His female counterpart is {{ga|Hilda}}.

==In the core series games==
==={{game|Black and White|s}}===
====As the playable character====
Hilbert is a 14-year-old boy who lives in [[Nuvema Town]], as do his [[Friend|childhood friends]], [[Cheren]] and [[Bianca]]. If chosen as the player, he will receive a [[first partner Pokémon]] and a [[Pokédex]] from [[Professor Juniper]]. After setting off on his [[Pokémon journey]] at the same time as Cheren and Bianca, Hilbert will at some point be asked by [[Fennel]] to do some sort of quest; in return for its completion, Hilbert will receive a [[C-Gear]].

As well as encountering and battling his childhood friends at various points during his journey, Hilbert will also meet a young man known as [[N]], who wishes to create separate worlds for humans and Pokémon. In order to achieve his goals, he and Hilbert will battle several times during the course of the game. Hilbert also battles [[Team Plasma]] at various stages of his journey. Ultimately, Hilbert is recognized as a hero by {{p|Reshiram}}{{Sup/5|B}}/{{p|Zekrom}}{{Sup/5|W}}.

====As a non-playable character====
If not chosen as the player, Hilbert appears as the player's partner in the [[Battle Subway]] when choosing to ride the Multi-Train. Two of the following Pokémon are picked from the corresponding list, depending on what the player wants him to base his team on. If the player chooses "A balance between the two," Hilbert's Pokémon are chosen from either list. 

==={{B2W2}}===
In Black 2 and White 2, the protagonist of Black and White was said to be searching for N in a faraway region and has not yet returned home. His mom mistakes the player for him.

==In the spin-off games==
===[[Pokémon Masters EX]]===
{{main|Hilbert (Masters)}}
Hilbert, who is based on the [[player character]] from {{game|Black and White|s|Pokémon Black}}, forms a [[sync pair]] with {{p|Oshawott}} and its evolved forms {{p|Dewott}} and {{p|Samurott}}, along with {{p|Mightyena}}, {{p|Genesect}}, {{p|Glaceon}}, {{form|Thundurus|Incarnate Forme}} {{p|Thundurus}}, and {{Shiny}} {{form|Kyurem|White}} {{p|Kyurem}} in [[Pokémon Masters EX]]. Hilbert became a playable sync pair on September 24, 2019.

In this game, his reason for looking for {{mas|N}} during the events of {{B2W2}} is revealed to be due to N having left too suddenly for Hilbert to say goodbye to him, which is similar to what Hilbert's mom also says in Black 2 and White 2. Hilbert first appeared as an NPC during the eighteenth chapter of the [[PML arc]]. He also made a notable appearance later in the [[villain arc]].

==Trivia==
* From a {{wp|bird's-eye view}}, Hilbert's hat looks like a {{i|Poké Ball}}.
* [[Pokémon Black 2 and White 2 beta#Pokémon World Tournament|Unused text]] in {{B2W2}} indicates that Hilbert and {{ga|Hilda}} were originally planned as opponents at the [[Pokémon World Tournament]].
* Hilbert and Hilda are the first [[player character]]s in the [[core series]] {{pkmn|games}} not to have pre-programmed names either by choice or in case one isn't specified.
* In the May 2010 volume of [[CoroCoro]] Comics and the January 2011 volume of Nintendo Dream, it was stated that Hilbert and Hilda are older than previous player characters, but it is not said how much older they actually are.
** According to game scenario author [[Toshinobu Matsumiya]], Hilbert and Hilda were initially visualized to be at the age of 16. This currently lines up with how old they would be in {{B2W2}}.<ref>[http://archive.is/THahx Twitter | マツミや @matsumiyan]</ref>
* Hilbert's name may be a reference to {{wp|David Hilbert}}, a German mathematician who developed {{wp|Hilbert's program}} in an attempt to prove mathematical truth. This is similar to the theme of truth and ideals throughout Black and White.
** This is also similar to [[N]]'s mathematical motifs.
* [[Ash Ketchum|Ash's]] appearance in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White|Pokėmon the Series: Black and White]]'', is inspired by Hilbert's design. Ash's outfit is slightly altered, having a primarily white jacket with short sleeves and a light blue top; and his hat being white in the front and red in the back (being the inverse of Hilbert's).

==Names==
This character is named '''Hilbert''' (Japanese: '''トウヤ''' ''Touya'') in his NPC appearance in the [[Battle Subway]]. It is also his most commonly used name, being used in merchandising and in {{g|Masters EX}}. His Japanese name was spelled as '''Touya''' on the packaging of [[Kotobukiya figurines|Kotobukiya ArtFX J Figure]].<ref>[https://www.kotobukiya-collection.com/2026/figures/19412/ Kotobukiya Collection]</ref>

He was named '''Black''' (Japanese: '''ブラック''' ''Black'') in certain pre-release material. English demos for Black and White refer to the character as '''Blair''', while English screenshots refer to him as '''Kuro'''.  If a transferred Pokémon that has a trainer with a [[Poké Transporter#Censored words|prohibited name]] comes from Black or Black 2, the Pokémon's OT will also be set to '''Kuro*''' (Japanese: '''ブラック．''' ''Black.''), while Pokémon from White or White 2 will have their OT set to '''Shiro*''' (Japanese: '''ホワイト．''' ''White.'').
